root_cause: The 2022 'skip loading large TEXT/BLOB column content for IS NULL/NOT NULL checks' optimization tagged the preceding OP_Column opcode with OPFLAG_TYPEOFARG based solely on which register held the operand, without distinguishing a disposable temporary register (safe to taint) from a shared/cached column register that could be read again later for its genuine value (e.g. by a CHECK constraint referencing the same column). This conflated two different lifetimes of the same register number.
findings: sqlite3ExprIfTrue()/sqlite3ExprIfFalse() code the IS NULL / IS NOT NULL operators by evaluating the operand into register r1 via sqlite3ExprCodeTemp(), then unconditionally call sqlite3VdbeTypeofColumn(v, r1).
